description: This file defines a React component named CourseBreakdown, which renders a detailed progress breakdown of courses, including course status badges, modules, and progress bars. It utilizes external icon components from 'lucide-react' and data from '@/data/progressData'.
external_methods: new Date() // method used for date formatting

methods.name: getStatusBadge
methods.description: Returns a badge component with styling based on the course status (completed, in_progress, not_started).

methods.name: getProgressBarColor
methods.description: Determines the color class for the progress bar based on completion percentage.

methods.name: CourseBreakdown
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the course progress breakdown UI with collapsible modules.
